name: Squadron
description: Spawns and runs its members (entries naming it with +0x11). With a door id it keeps those doors locked until every member is dead. MSR D9 'Squadron entry'. Unnamed bytes are copied 1:1: start from a stock squadron of the same baddy type.

fields.name: behaviour
fields.description: what members do normally: 0x11 (17) smart, walks inside its region to the hero; 9 sentry, never walks and only faces its fixed heading (decomp MSR 'What makes squad members move and turn')

fields.name: alertBehaviour
fields.description: what members do when alerted (the hero seen or heard)

fields.name: count
fields.description: member count (the door unlock checks this many saved flags)

fields.name: size
fields.description: the members' size in hundredths (40 = 0.40, stock ants; 0 = 1.0). It replaces the definition's scale, and every member shares it (decomp MSR 'Phase 2 prep: drawn size and facing')

fields.name: trigger
fields.description: when the squad spawns: 3 at once; 1 when a hero enters the zone at the squadron's position + (+0x1F, +0x20, +0x21) x 16, radius +0x22 x 16 (a stock squad's zone is where it stood in its own level)

fields.name: doorId
fields.description: doors with this id stay locked until the squadron is dead (0 = none)

fields.name: baddyType
fields.description: the member object id (0x78 is an ant)

fields.name: flags
fields.description: 0x40 members go for the hero at once; 0x400 always face the target (bit 3 cleared on load)

fields.name: drop
fields.description: pickup dropped when the last member dies

fields.name: region
fields.description: navigation region (0-127: the game reads it signed); the list must have region corners for it
